setup.text: Jars line the cleared shelf, their contents barely filling the glass. Mara holds one up to the light and sets it back down with a frown. "This one won't keep past the week without help."

option_a.text: The player hands over a measure of salt. Mara works it into the jar's seal, checking it again under the light — "There, that should hold."

option_b.text: The player casts preserve on the freshly cut herbs beside the jars. The wilting herbs stop mid-drop as the spell takes hold. Mara notices the change but does not look up.

option_c.text:
"Which ones are close?"

Mara points to two jars, then returns her attention to the shelf.
